newsitem.title: USA: McClain Industries sees Q4 on par with Q3.
newsitem.headline: McClain Industries sees Q4 on par with Q3.

text.p: McClain Industries Inc said Tuesday it expects fourth quarter results to be comparable to those of the third quarter, which saw a drop in net income despite higher sales.

"While sales continue to increase compared to the prior year, gross profit margins remain under pressure due to the competitive market," Kenneth McClain, president, said in a statement. "We expect fourth quarter sales and earnings to be comparable to the third quarter results."

McClain, which makes solid waste handling and transportation equipment a well as dump truck bodies, today reported earnings for the third quarter, ended June 30 of $1.0 million or $0.21 a share, down from $1.9 million, or $0.40 a share, a year ago. Sales rose to $26.1 million from $24.9 million.
McClain said it is committed to sales and earnings growth.
